kiro-ide-mcp-integration.description: Kiro IDE MCP configuration for OverdriveDB AI Agent
how-to-setup: 1. Locate Kiro IDE settings file (usually in .kiro/settings.json or kiro-config.json)
2. Add the 'mcp' section from above to your Kiro settings
3. Replace /path/to/ with the absolute path to your OBD-intnero folder
6. When you type, the AI provider dropdown should show 'overdrive-agent'

solutions: 1. Verify node.js is installed and in PATH
2. Check MCP server is running (npm run mcp)
3. Verify path in config is absolute, not relative
4. Check ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var is set
5. View Kiro debug logs for MCP connection errors
